channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Fresh storm in Lok Sabha over 'yaar': Rahul Gandhi rakes up memoir, Chair objects
item.description: While Rahul Gandhi remained unrelenting and the Chair repeatedly objected to it, the House witnessed loud uproar and noisy scenes. The Opposition members resorted to sloganeering, protesting against the Chair's decision to deny the Leader of Opposition.

item.title: CJ Roy suicide case: Too early to link death to I-T pressure, says K'taka Home Minister
item.description: Karnataka Home Minister G. Parameshwara on Tuesday said it was too early to link the suicide of Bengaluru-based industrialist and Confident Group Founder C.J. Roy to alleged pressure from the Income Tax department. He stated that conclusions should be drawn only after the completion of the investigation.

item.title: "Exit India if you can't': SC reprimands WhatsApp, Meta over data sharing for ads, questions user privacy
item.description: The Supreme Court sharply criticised WhatsApp and its parent company Meta over the sharing of user data for targeted advertising, warning that citizens' privacy cannot be compromised. Making strong observations, the court said such practices amount to exploitation of user data and questioned how ordinary Indians could be expected to understand complex privacy policies.

item.title: Gold chains worth nearly Rs 30 lakh stolen during Ajit Pawar's funeral in Baramati; six held
item.description: A shocking incident has surfaced from Baramati, where the somber atmosphere of Ajit Pawar's funeral was exploited by a gang of thieves. Despite the presence of nearly 8,000 police personnel and top VVIPs, gold chains worth approximately ₹30 lakh were snatched from at least 15 mourners.

item.title: FIR against Dhurandhar team for flying drones without permission in Mumbai
item.description: Mumbai Police have registered a case against the location manager of Dhurandhar 2 for flying a drone without permission in South Mumbai's high-security Fort area. An FIR was filed at MRA Marg Police Station against Rinku Rajpal Valmiki under Section 223 of the IPC for allegedly ignoring official orders.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty post moderate gains as IT stocks plunge over 'SaaSpocalypse'
item.description: As of 9.25 am, Sensex added 44 points, or 0.05 per cent, to reach 83,783, and Nifty gained 51 points, or 0.20 per cent to settle at 25,778.

item.title: Musk's net worth soars past $800 billion after SpaceX‑xAI deal
item.description: Elon Musk has become the richest person in history after his net worth surged past $800 billion following SpaceX's acquisition of his AI firm xAI.

item.title: Mahesh Babu says he trained himself for 6 months for role in SS Rajamouli's Varanasi
item.description: Mahesh Babu said that he trained for six months to modify his walking and running style for the role in director SS Rajamouli's upcoming movie Varanasi.

item.title: Shivering at traffic lights: CWC orders rescue drive for begging children in Jammu
item.description: Moved by complaints highlighting the plight of children begging at traffic signals amid harsh winter conditions, the CWC, Jammu, has ordered immediate rescue and rehabilitation of minors found on city roads.

item.title: Fake EWS, forged PWD certificates used to bag MBBS seats at SKIMS Srinagar; case registered
item.description: The Economic Offences Wing (EOW) of the Crime Branch Kashmir has registered a criminal case against two individuals for allegedly using fake and forged EWS and PWD certificates to secure admission to the MBBS Course–2023 at SKIMS Soura.
